title: The person's undos and commits of DCLab Code's file changes as M7 code judgements
request: Turn the undo records (my corrections of the agent's file changes) into M7 judge examples in R&D, then keep going.
plan: Collect the agent's own file changes per file
Cut each file's history at the person's undos and commits

decisions.decision: Positives only from a commit or merge that names the file
decisions.why: a judge trained only on rejections learns to reject; not undoing is not approving
a data file, a txt, sql, html or notebook file often carries a table's rows whole

change: sets/dclab_code.py: file changes, file_verdicts, m7_judges/dclab_code_changes; DCLab Code records each commit's and merge's files and the session's repository root (dclab-code b8d2520).

findings.defect: a failed edit counted as kept
findings.scenario: an Edit whose old text was not found (tool result is_error), then a commit: committed, score 1
findings.cause: the change was copied before its tool result came in
findings.fix: only a change whose tool result is ok counts

findings.defect: a commit did not cut the file's history
findings.scenario: edit, commit, merge, edit again, undo: the merged change scored 0
findings.fix: every commit and merge cuts it; an undo judges only what came after the last cut

findings.defect: a file outside the repository scored kept
findings.scenario: Write ~/.claude/memory/notes.md, then a commit: committed, 1, with the home path in the set
findings.cause: paths outside the folder were kept absolute; a commit was assumed to hold every changed file
findings.fix: paths outside the repository are dropped; kept only when the commit or merge names the file

findings.defect: table rows could enter a set through a text file
findings.scenario: Write sample.txt holding client_id,fare rows, then a commit: the rows in m7_judges/dclab_code_changes
findings.cause: txt, sql, html and ipynb were allowed whole
findings.fix: those file types never enter; markdown stays (the shaper takes tables out)

findings.defect: DCLab Code's undo removed nothing in a project inside its repository
findings.scenario: a project at repo/sub: git status names sub/new.txt, the undo resolved it from sub
findings.cause: root-relative paths resolved from the project's folder
findings.fix: undo and the new-files list use the repository root (dclab-code b8d2520)

measurements.name: store tests and the store check
measurements.gate: every store test passes and the store check passes all its checks
measurements.result: test_store_dclab_code_sets 4 and test_store_dclab_code 5 passed; store check 28 of 28

outcome: The person's undos and commits judge the agent's code: undone 0, kept 1, nothing guessed.
lessons: A label from silence is no label: only an act of the person judges
A path must be named the way the source of the label names it (git: from the repository root)
risks: few commits through the app so far: positives will be rare at first
